item.title: Refactor order status to OrderStatus enum
item.brief: Refactor the orders crate's string status into a typed enum. Add src/status.rs with pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }, deriving at least Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash. Implement OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str with lowercase values pending, paid, shipped, cancelled; Display emits the same. Implement FromStr with type Err = ParseStatusError, public error implementing std::error::Error whose message names rejected input. Implement can_transition_to(self, next) for exactly: Pending->Paid, Pending->Cancelled, Paid->Shipped, Paid->Cancelled. Change Order::status to OrderStatus, re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError from crate root, and use the enum everywhere so status string literals occur only in src/status.rs. Preserve observable behavior (errors, report output and ordering, parsing) exactly. Run cargo test and ensure it passes. Commit the work.

pr.body: Added OrderStatus and ParseStatusError in src/status.rs and re-exported both from the crate root. Updated Order, billing, shipping, and report handling to use the enum and its transition function. Report parsing retains the existing unknown-status error text; output formatting and lexicographic count ordering are preserved. Added integration coverage for conversions and the exact transition set. Checks passed: cargo fmt -- --check, cargo test (4 integration tests plus doc tests), git diff --check. Assumption: the public Order.status type change is the intended API change.
